title: Hung Curd Protein Bowl
subtitle: A five-minute high-protein bowl, built two ways — sweet or savory.

nightPrep.label: Night Before — essential
items: Line colander with muslin cloth; pour in yogurt {500g}; tie and hang over a bowl in the fridge
By morning: thick hung curd with ~2× protein density; save drained whey for roti dough

method.title: Morning assembly
items: Unwrap hung curd — should be thick like labneh
Divide into two adult bowls {~¾ cup each}
Sweet: drizzle honey {1 tsp}, add fruit {½ cup}, top with seeds and nuts
Savory: stir in kala namak and cumin {¼ tsp}, top with cucumber {¼ cup}, coriander, seeds and nuts

method.label: Toddler bowl
items: Use regular full-fat yogurt (not hung) — easier texture
Add mashed banana or soft fruit {¼ cup}
Top with finely ground almonds {1 tsp} — no whole nuts (choking hazard)
Optional: mash in a small boiled potato for extra calories

method.label: Protein math
method.text: Hung curd yields ~10–12g protein per 100g. Hemp seeds add 10g per 3 tbsp. Together with nuts you're at 22–28g with zero cooking.
